subject: Mobile Development
title: Code Signing and Trust
description: One-minute skill: Code Signing and Trust.

hook.text: How does your phone know an app is genuine and hasn't been tampered with?

buildup.text: Every app is digitally signed with the developer's certificate before it reaches the store.

discovery.text: The OS verifies the signature at install time. If it doesn't match, installation is blocked.

twist.text: Stolen signing certificates have been used to distribute malware disguised as legitimate apps.

climax.text: Code signing creates a chain of trust from the developer's machine to the user's phone.

punchline.text: A digital signature proves who built the app.

quiz.question: What does code signing verify?
options: That the app hasn't been tampered with
That the app uses dark mode
